decision_cruda.rationale: LH-04 hydraulic failure at C590-05. The radio and OT-5100 agree that it is down, so no confirmation is needed. The CMMS estimate is 0.25-0.5 h, likely 0.4 h, with the repair on site. Central is truck-limited: 4 trucks, and the Central stockpile holds 264 t of its 450 t capacity. Because of that, the lost 0.4 h of mucking at C590-05 (about 17 t at 7.5 g/t) is small and mostly absorbed by the stockpile buffer. Any loan would arrive after travel time of at least 0.5 h, once the repair is nearly done. LH-08 would cost 1.9 oz/h and LH-09 would cost 4.0 oz/h in development value. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 11:00. LH-07 is the only other loader that could be borrowed, and Norte has no stopped stope. No reserve can be activated because no stope is stopped. A loan costs more than it would recover, so I am making no moves. Net change versus doing nothing is 0 oz.

confirmations_requested.ask: Call the Central area chief. Confirm that LH-04 is down with the hydraulic failure and that the part is not in stock. OT-5100 says 0.25-0.5 h on site, but the revised OT-5101 says 5-8 h from 09:30 (back about 14:30-17:30). Also ask for the actual return time.

decision_cruda.rationale: No loan pays, so I recommend no moves. LH-04's failure at C590-05 (OT-5101: 5-8 h) leaves Central with 3 working loaders. Central is truck-limited: 4 trucks at about 23.5 t/h each (my estimate) give about 94 t/h. The three remaining LH514s muck about 43 + 41 + 36 = 120 t/h, which is above that. The stockpile also holds 278 t. A replacement loader at Central would add nothing. Este is also truck-limited: 2 loaders at about 79 t/h against 3 trucks at about 70 t/h. Norte has only one stope with broken ore, N548-10. It has 189 t left and LH-07 mucks about 29 t/h, so it clears that ore by 17:00 without help. The other Norte stopes are in fill or drilling and have no ore to muck. Taking a loader from DS-C512-01 (1.9 oz/h) or DS-E543-02 (4.0 oz/h) costs development value and gains no ore. The only spare, LH-10, is in preventive maintenance until 11:00 and would need about 0.6 h to reach Norte, so it would add essentially no hauled oz. No reserve can be activated, because RESERVE-01 needs a loader from a stopped stope and LH-04 is broken, so it is not a free loader. The CMMS entries are consistent with the radio that the loader is down. The only discrepancy is between the old and revised estimates, so I ask the area chief to confirm the status and return time without moving anything.
